title: Grant or GrantData is paired with an outstanding Acquire

source.statement: AcquireBlock and AcquirePerm requests receive Grant or GrantData responses, which in turn require GrantAck.

trigger_event.description: an AcquireBlock or AcquirePerm is accepted

response_event.description: a matching Grant or GrantData response is accepted

preconditions: source identifiers are not reused while an Acquire remains outstanding

required_observations.description: Grant lacks an outstanding Acquire or an Acquire source is reused
